subject: Post-discovery: technical deep dive scheduling & agenda

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@smartcommerce.ai>, Tom Owens <tom.owens@smartcommerce.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T17:02:00Z
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive (60–90min)

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick post-call recap and next steps so we can lock a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML/infra team and your platform folks.

Outcome from today
- Good fit on model-serving use case (real-time chat + batched async embedding jobs)
- Main constraints: strict latency SLOs (95th percentile), multi-tenant isolation, and audit logs for compliance

Proposed next step
- 60–90 minute technical deep dive (architecture, perf expectations, security controls, rollout plan) with the following attendees:
  - From SmartCommerce: ML/Infra lead, App Platform lead, Security contact
  - From Redwood: Marissa (AE), Mateo (ML/Infra), Logan (Solutions)

Three slots we can offer (all PDT):
- Option A: Tue Aug 25, 09:00–10:30
- Option B: Wed Aug 26, 11:00–12:30
- Option C: Thu Sep 3, 08:30–10:00

Ask: Please let us know which option works for you, and who from your side will join (names + emails) so we can add them to the invite. If none of these work, share two 60–90 minute windows that do.

Draft agenda (attached): overview & goals, infra/latency targets, data/security requirements, short perf demo (15m), Q&A & rollout next steps.

Attachments: draft_agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

Logan

Thanks Logan — this looks good.

Quick notes:
- Option A or C would work for us; Option B is tricky because our infra standup is then. Leaning toward Option A.
- I’m adding our Security lead, Priya Rao (priya.rao@smartcommerce.ai) on this thread — she’ll need to join for the data isolation & audit logs discussion.
- Please include any pre-read or short questionnaire we should complete ahead of the session — specifically we’d like a short list of examples of the data flows and what evidence you typically present for compliance.

Also, can you confirm whether the perf demo will include a representative QPS / token-length profile? That will help us decide which environments to have available.

Great — thanks for the quick reply and for adding Priya.

We can definitely show a perf demo with a representative QPS/token mix. For prep, two quick asks so we come focused:
1) Can you share your expected peak QPS and typical prompt lengths (avg tokens and max tokens)? A rough range is fine.
2) Any must-cover compliance items beyond data retention, audit logs, and encryption at rest (e.g., specific regional controls)?

I created a quick time poll to capture availability; if you prefer, tell us directly which option you want and we’ll send a calendar invitation. Poll: https://doodle.com/poll/tdx-smartcommerce-rdw (placeholder)

HubSpot: I updated the deal record RDW-2384 with the proposed agenda and the attendees list — link in metadata.

If Option A is good, we’ll plan for a 90-minute slot and include a 15-minute perf demo (configurable). I’ll ask Mateo to confirm internal availability.

Thanks —
Logan

- Representative load (QPS) and token-length profiles you can provide so we can map to kernel/quantization recommendations

- Fallbacks and canary policy for model upgrades

I’m planning to run a short 10–15 minute demo showing token-latency under an internal micro-benchmark, then switch to discussion. Attaching a short runbook for our internal prep.
